morphology.pattern_note: 在马来语中作为完整人名处理，无马来语词缀音变；不能把开头 sa- 或结尾 -sha 分析为马来语词缀。

senses.zh_definition: Sasha，人名，常音译为“萨沙”；在俄语和乌克兰语中是 Aleksandr 或 Aleksandra 的昵称形式，也在其他语言中用作独立名字。
senses.en_definition: A personal name used for both men and women, originating as a Russian and Ukrainian diminutive of Aleksandr or Aleksandra.
senses.ms_definition: Nama peribadi yang digunakan oleh lelaki dan perempuan, berasal daripada bentuk panggilan mesra bagi Aleksandr atau Aleksandra dalam bahasa Rusia dan Ukraine.
senses.nuances: 属于专有名词，规范书写为 Sasha，不是表示某种普通事物的马来语通名。不能仅凭此名推断性别、国籍或宗教，也不能断定输入指某位名人或角色。来源及读音差异参见[Behind the Name：Sasha](https://www.behindthename.com/name/sasha)。

etymology.historical_story: Sasha began as a familiar form of Aleksandr and Aleksandra in Russian and Ukrainian. Because it can refer to either name, its traditional use includes both men and women. It also travels across languages as an independent given name, showing how an affectionate short form can acquire a life beyond its original naming system. See [Behind the Name](https://www.behindthename.com/name/sasha).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 想象通讯录里并排两位都叫 Sasha 的朋友：名字相同，性别可以不同。把它整词记作人名，不拆成马来语词根。
